<style>
/* Shopify-style grid */
.resource-container {
    max-width: 1400px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 3rem 2rem;
    font-family: inherit; /* Inherits your Quarto Sketchy/Theme font */
}

.resource-header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 4rem;
}

.resource-header h1 {
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.resource-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
    gap: 3rem 2rem;
}

.product-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
    transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
}

.product-card:hover {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
}

/* Image container - SQUARE BOX */
.product-image-wrapper {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 1/1; /* Forces square shape */
    background-color: #f7f7f7;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: 8px; 
    margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

body.quarto-dark .product-image-wrapper,
[data-bs-theme="dark"] .product-image-wrapper {
    background-color: #1a1a1a;
}

.product-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover; /* Change to 'contain' if you want full PDF showing */
    transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
}

.product-card:hover .product-image {
    transform: scale(1.05); /* Shopify style gentle zoom on hover */
}

/* Badges */
.badge-sale {
    position: absolute;
    top: 12px;
    left: 12px;
    background-color: #000;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 5px 10px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    z-index: 2;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

body.quarto-dark .badge-sale,
[data-bs-theme="dark"] .badge-sale {
    background-color: #fff;
    color: #000;
}

/* Content */
.product-info {
    text-align: left;
}

.product-vendor {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: #666;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

body.quarto-dark .product-vendor,
[data-bs-theme="dark"] .product-vendor {
    color: #aaa;
}

.product-title {
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    line-height: 1.3;
}

/* Price */
.product-price-container {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.price-regular {
    text-decoration: line-through;
    color: #888;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.price-sale {
    color: #d93025; /* Red for sale */
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.price-free {
    color: #1a73e8; /* Clean blue for free */
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

body.quarto-dark .price-free,
[data-bs-theme="dark"] .price-free {
    color: #66b2ff;
}

/* Button */
.btn-add-to-cart {
    width: 100%;
    background-color: transparent;
    color: #000;
    border: 1px solid #000;
    padding: 0.8rem;
    text-align: center;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    border-radius: 4px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.btn-add-to-cart:hover {
    background-color: #000;
    color: #fff;
}

body.quarto-dark .btn-add-to-cart,
[data-bs-theme="dark"] .btn-add-to-cart {
    border-color: #fff;
    color: #fff;
}

body.quarto-dark .btn-add-to-cart:hover,
[data-bs-theme="dark"] .btn-add-to-cart:hover {
    background-color: #fff;
    color: #000;
}
</style>
